# hush_custom_api_application (Data Source)

A custom API app, read by name, with its tools. Its secret is never returned, so the data source has no attribute for it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_custom_api_application" "billing" {
  name = "billing"
}

output "billing_tool_names" {
  value = data.hush_custom_api_application.billing.tool[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The custom app's name.

### Read-Only

- `app_catalog_id` (String) The id an application is created from: the name prefixed with 'custom-'.
- `auth` (List of Object) The fixed credential the gateway presents to the API, without its secret; empty when there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `description` (String) A description of the custom app.
- `detect_required` (Boolean) Whether `url` or `spec_url` changed since the tools were last detected.
- `display_name` (String) The name the custom app is shown under.
- `headers` (Map of String) Extra HTTP headers the gateway sends with every request to the API.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `spec_url` (String) The address of the API's OpenAPI spec, which the console detects the tools from.
- `tool` (List of Object) The API's tools, as detected or as written. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tool))
- `url` (String) The API's address. A tool's `path` is taken from its host, not appended to its path.
